name: piskelapp/piskel
description: A simple web-based pixel art and sprite animation editor with live preview, built entirely in JavaScript. Supports export to GIF, PNG spritesheet, and ZIP, and runs as a desktop app.
score_rationale: 12.4k stars, widely used free web-based sprite editor beloved by game jammers and indie devs for quick pixel art creation.
summary: Web-based pixel art and sprite animation editor with live preview
